statement:
Some entries in the table of contents of our generated user guide do nothing when clicked, while others work. In-page links that `docpipe.check()` accepts are dead in the rendered HTML for the same sections. Among the affected headings:

    ## Configuring [the CLI](cli.md)
    # Setup[^first-run]

We render with `docpipe.render(source, options=Options(toc=True))`, sometimes with a `RenderCache` and a `heading_offset`. The headings themselves look right.

The tests under `tests/` are owned by QA and are read-only; do not modify them. Make sure the existing test suite still passes.
notes: HtmlRenderer.visit_heading slugs the heading's raw markup with a Slugger kept on the renderer instead of using the id transforms.assign_heading_ids gave the node, so markup in headings and renderer reuse produce ids the TOC and check() do not know. ANALYSIS ONLY: never shown to agents.
